title: Aliens
synopsis: Marines, a colony gone silent, a little girl in the vents, and a queen who has a very strong opinion about her eggs.

nodes.text: Fifty-seven years of sleep and a hearing about a lifeboat full of nothing.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Brave.
There is no taking “Quit and walk” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Drop pod and Hudson loud and Vasquez quiet and a Smartgun checklist on a screen.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Wise.
You commit to “Stay silent.” The story records the instinct as “Tired” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Wind. Acid rain. Atmosphere processor humming a wrong chord.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Sweep the comm tower” back. Strategic shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Sweep the medlab” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Hunch.

nodes.text: Colonists in the walls of medlab, two still warm enough to scream.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Mercy.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Heart—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: A girl in a vent who has not been hugged in weeks.

choices.consequence: “Coax her out” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Care.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Cold.

nodes.text: The reactor under your boots and a sergeant who fires anyway.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.
“Obey orders” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Loyal.

nodes.text: Eggs in the dark. Drones from the ceiling. Apone, Dietrich, Frost, Crowe — gone.

nodes.text: Sound of a wet thing moving past a grille.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Cunning.

nodes.text: A vent slips and pulls her down a chute toward a darkness with eyes in it.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Crawl after her” back. Loyal shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Burn the eggs” back. Final shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
There is no taking “Sneak past” back. Cautious shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: She lifts her ovipositor and gestures: leave, and we leave.

nodes.text: Queen on the underside of the ship, eggs in her teeth.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Bold—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Loader arms, claws, the cold of space waiting just past the door.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Open the airlock” back. Final shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Cunning—follows you into whatever comes next.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: Bishop's torso in a cot, Newt's small hand in yours, a fifty-year ride home with better dreams this time.
You come back to the surface anyway, with five hundred Colonial Marines and a plan that the Queen has not yet predicted.
She asks if she can dream now. You say yes. She does. So do you. Both of you for the first time in weeks.
